# getjinai.com

> getjinai.com handles sales for Jin AI and is operated by Jin AI. Jin AI is the GTM engineer agent for B2B SaaS marketing teams. It learns how a team's best marketers run campaigns, such as events, webinars and product launches, and turns that work into agentic workflows the whole team can run. Jin uses only company-approved data, and marketers see and edit what Jin learns. Customer data is not used to train AI models. The official site is https://jinai.md/.

## Pages

- [Get Jin AI | The GTM Engineer Agent for B2B SaaS Marketing Teams](https://getjinai.com/): Shop by campaign type, compare ways to start, and set up your first campaign workflow.
- [Jin AI for Teams: Product Details, Specifications, and Q&A | getjinai](https://getjinai.com/jin-ai-for-teams/): Product details, admin controls, privacy, and answers to common questions.
- [Jin AI by Campaign and Role](https://getjinai.com/solutions/): Events, webinars, product launches, ABM, nurture, content
- [Services](https://getjinai.com/services/): Campaign selection, context setup, capture review, results review, pilot
- [Support](https://getjinai.com/support/): Contact, security and privacy, FAQ

## Key facts

- Category: GTM engineer agent for B2B SaaS marketing teams
- How it works: a Context Layer as the foundation (brand guidelines, product catalog, messaging, ICP, past campaigns, customer insights); capture how each marketer works across tools on their desktop; turn that work into agentic campaign workflows; roll out the best version to the whole team
- Example workflow: an event marketing manager's event (targets, stakeholder meetings, demand gen, venue, speakers, content, follow-up)
- Trust: only company-approved data; marketers see and edit what Jin learns; workflows run only with approval; never used to train AI models; each company's data kept separate
- How to start: one campaign workflow your team already runs (pilot)
- Demo and contact: https://jinai.md/ (hello@jinai.md)
